title: Q-SPEC-04-seed-keep-or-revert: Keep or revert a plus on measured evidence in the seed tick
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q "US-04-T03" -- seed/worker/test
**Status:** closed

US-SPEC-04 (US-04-R06 to R11): the seed tick measures the plus share and emits successors, but stores no baseline when a plus ships and never reverts one on a miss; the full loop is `workers/core/plus`. Load the plus module's step in the seed tick, or port its keep-or-revert rule, so a shipped plus item is settled against its metric and guard after its window, with an unmeasured reading never kept.

size: L

**Prediction:** spec_quality >= 0.9 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** the generator that writes a plus, and usage readers that need a live analytics credential.

**Closing probe:** cmd:`git grep -q "US-04-T03" -- seed/worker/test` exits 0, and `python3 scripts/spec_ids.py --check` passes with the status line of the specification changed from PLANNED to BUILT naming the file and the test.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T14:19:27Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
